messages.subject: [REMINDER]: Airflow Dev call on 16th July
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

Here is a quick reminder that we have our Airflow dev call tomorrow, on
Thursday, 16th July 2026 at 8AM PST (11 am EST | 4 pm UTC / GMT).

Proposed agenda:



   - Release updates - 3.3.1 (Rahul Vats)
   - Catch-up on action items from last call
   - TBD
   - Development Updates
      - Common AI provider (Kaxil / Vikram)
      - TBD
   - Discussion topics:
   - TBD

For additions to the agenda, please feel free to add a comment to the wiki
page or slack or send me an email. The summary of the call will also be
sent to the mailing list and posted on the same wiki page.
As a reminder the zoom link is
https://astronomer.zoom.us/j/84124767391?pwd=3vatlR8OuF6Uy2JbOcKrw6034CayFG.1

Looking forward to seeing you all soon,
Vikram

-- 

Vikram Koka
Chief Strategy Officer
Email: vikram@astronomer.io


<https://www.astronomer.io/>
